people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.
translations.bsb: “He saved others, but He cannot save Himself. He is the King of Israel! Let Him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in Him.
translations.kjv: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
translations.asv: He saved others; himself he cannot save. He is the King of Israel; let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe on him.
